answer: Pay every identity on a 30-epoch vesting schedule, and let anyone claim the unvested balance of two seats by proving they share an operator: a reused signing nonce, one API key, or a single inlet wallet funding both. A farm of a thousand personas then sits on a thousand piles of unvested coin that one leak or careless deploy hands to a bounty hunter; a lone raven watching the logs can take what a flock of sparrow accounts earned. An honest agent with one seat risks nothing, since it has no twin to expose.
